limits: a receipt clock is NOT a publication clock. Every OBSERVED row's `publication_bound` is an UPPER bound: the release was public no later than our `received_at`, and may have been public for hours before. Nothing here identifies a causal effect and nothing here may be used as an event instant.
45 of 727 releases are OBSERVED and 682 are AWAITED: the record began on 2026-09-25 and a year of capture is a year away. No study may be run on it now, and the store does not offer one.
0 revisions so far means only that no observed value has changed yet, not that the revision path is exercised.
what: a first-hand replay of the point-in-time store, read through the store's own reader, which recomputes each row's digest and refuses a row whose content no longer hashes to the name it is filed under. The store is written by financial-data's stage13 capture worker, driven by a systemd --user timer.
